description:
Kernel auto-selection v2 is a Serving Runtime Performance initiative to ship improved GPU kernel selection logic keyed on (1) model family/architecture, (2) sequence length regime (prefill/decode characteristics), and (3) GPU type/SKU. The goal is to reduce p95/p99 latency and improve throughput stability across heterogeneous fleets (e.g., A100/H100/L40S) while keeping correctness and determinism guarantees.

Scope includes: updating the runtime’s kernel selection module (feature extraction, scoring/decision rules, fallbacks), adding observability for per-request selection decisions, expanding benchmark coverage (model families + seq-length distributions + GPU SKUs), and introducing a safe rollout mechanism (feature gates, per-model allowlists/denylists, rapid rollback). It also includes documentation and operational runbooks for debugging and overrides, especially for Dedicated/Private customers with constrained GPU types.

Key stakeholders: Runtime Kernels (Hiro Tanaka, Grace Kim, Yuki Sato, Isabella Rossi), Runtime Scheduling (Sofia Ivanova, Lena Fischer, Marcus Reed), Runtime architecture/perf guardrails (Noah Patel, Omar El-Sayed), Performance & Evals (Jonas Weber, Claire Dubois), Platform Control Plane / policy gates (Ethan Park, Benji Okafor, Jordan Lee), Release Engineering (Connor O’Brien, Sahana Iyer), SRE/Observability (Sean Gallagher, Allison Grant, Aisha Bello), and cross-functional program management (Talia Benson).

Phases & timeline (typical): (1) discovery + design (2–3 weeks), (2) implementation behind gates (3–5 weeks), (3) perf characterization + regression hardening (2–4 weeks), (4) staged canary rollout in Hosted, then Dedicated pools (1–3 weeks), (5) GA with updated runbooks and release notes. Constraints: zero correctness regressions, minimal selection nondeterminism, and guardrails to avoid tail-latency spikes from misclassification of long-context workloads; must support rapid rollback and manual overrides for customer escalations.

files.description: Primary design doc: motivation, current v1 behavior, new feature signals (model family, seq length buckets, GPU SKU), decision logic, fallback hierarchy, determinism guarantees, and open questions.
ADR capturing the chosen selection approach (rule-based vs learned scoring), feature set, and explicit fallback policy when kernels are missing/unstable on a SKU.
Benchmark plan + coverage table: model families (e.g., Llama/Mistral/Qwen/Gemma), prompt/decode distributions, GPU types, and pass/fail thresholds for latency/throughput deltas.
Profiling/debug guide: how to capture selection traces, compare kernels, reproduce with local flags, and interpret perf counters; includes common failure signatures.
Operational runbook for oncall: how to disable v2 by model/GPU/region, how to pin a kernel, how to roll back safely, and how to validate recovery with dashboards.
Living list of known issues: specific kernels unstable on certain SKUs/driver versions, long-context edge cases, and temporary allowlist/denylist rules.
Subsystem overview: where selection happens in the execution pipeline, interfaces to scheduler and compilation cache, and how selection decisions are cached/serialized.
Standard update: required telemetry fields for kernel selection, expectations for determinism/replayability, and performance regression gating requirements.
Dashboard spec for rollout monitoring: selection distribution by model/GPU/seq bucket, p95/p99 latency deltas, error rates, and rollback triggers.
SRE assessment: projected SLO impact, alert adjustments, canary criteria, and error-budget policy during staged rollout.
Runtime release note entry: feature summary, configuration/flags, expected perf impact, known limitations, and rollback instructions.
Epic tracking kernel auto-selection v2: milestones, rollout phases, links to design/ADRs, and sub-issues for runtime, platform gates, benchmarks, and observability.
Implementation task: add model-family classification and seq-length bucket extraction; includes acceptance criteria and unit test plan.
Task to introduce GPU-SKU keyed kernel mapping, safe fallbacks, and denylist plumbing for unstable kernel/SKU combinations.
Task to add per-request selection telemetry (chosen kernel, candidates, features) with sampling controls to limit overhead.
Benchmark/perf task: expand perf suite to cover long-context and mixed prompt distributions; define pass/fail thresholds.
Rollout mechanics: feature gate integration, per-model allowlist, staged region rollout, and rollback workflow definition.
Release engineering ticket to land v2 behind gates, coordinate canary windows, and ensure changelog + upgrade notes are complete.
Informal working doc: open questions, experiments, links to PRs, and scratch analysis of mis-selections seen in early testing.
Spreadsheet-style table of benchmark outputs (latency/throughput by model/GPU/seq bucket), comparisons vs v1, and notes on anomalies.
Checklist for staging/canary/GA: required metrics green, denylist reviewed, dashboards live, oncall briefed, rollback tested.
Launch brief deck draft: what ships in runtime 1.21, kernel auto-selection v2 highlights, risk areas, and comms plan.
PR implementing v2 selector core logic and interfaces; includes feature extraction, candidate generation, and baseline tests.
PR adding model-family detection (architecture tags) and routing into selection rules; includes edge-case handling for variants.
PR introducing seq-length regime bucketing and prefill/decode heuristics used by the selector; includes benchmarks in CI (lightweight).
PR adding GPU SKU dimension to kernel registry + explicit fallback precedence; includes denylist support for known-bad combinations.
PR adding feature gate and configuration plumbing for enabling v2 by environment/region/model; ties into runtime config loader.
PR emitting telemetry for kernel selection decisions (selected kernel, candidate set, features) with sampling/PII considerations.
PR adding deterministic replay tests ensuring identical selection decisions given same inputs; includes CI job wiring.
PR adding debugging flags to force kernel choice and dump selection traces for triage and customer escalations.
PR introducing guardrail to disable v2 on specific driver/CUDA combos until validation is complete; includes doc updates.
PR passing scheduler-derived workload hints (observed seq length distribution) into selector for mixed workload stability.
PR adding allowlist/denylist evaluation and hot reload behavior for rollout control; includes safety checks and metrics.
Follow-up PR after perf testing: adjusts rule thresholds to avoid long-context tail latency spikes; includes before/after plots.
PR adding perf-canary scenarios to compare v1 vs v2 selection across SKUs and seq buckets; includes alert thresholds.
PR adding microbenchmark measuring kernel-switch overhead and selector evaluation cost; used to bound telemetry overhead.
PR adding dashboard panels for selection distribution and latency deltas; includes example queries and cardinality controls.
PR adding SLO gating checks for rollout: p95/p99 regression budgets, error rate thresholds, and automated rollback recommendation.
Thread coordinating initial v2 design review: questions about rule ordering, determinism, and model-family tagging; includes quick consensus and action items.
Thread debating ADR choice (rule-based vs learned scoring), with concerns about explainability and rollback safety.
Thread triaging early benchmark anomalies on long-context prompts; includes logs/snippets and proposed threshold tweaks.
Thread on GPU SKU mapping confusion (A100 variants, MIG, cloud instance naming); includes proposed normalization scheme.
Thread coordinating feature gate + config rollout mechanics between Runtime and Control Plane; includes ownership split.
Thread on rollout monitoring: which dashboards/alerts to trust, sampling rate for telemetry, and rollback triggers.
Thread scheduling runtime 1.21 canary window, checklist review, and who is on point for rollback decision.
Thread discussing selector overhead measurements and whether to cache decisions per model/GPU/seq bucket.
Thread about a brief latency spike during canary (suspected mis-selection on one GPU SKU); includes incident-bot style updates and mitigation.
Thread between oncall and runtime engineers applying the runbook: disabling v2 for a specific model in one region and validating recovery.
Thread answering PM questions: expected customer-visible impact, how to describe it in release notes, and risk language.
Thread confirming GA criteria met: perf deltas, error rates, denylist status, and final approvals.
Customer support ticket: reported p99 latency regression for long-context requests on a specific GPU SKU; includes logs, investigation notes, and workaround via v2 disable/pin.
Internal support ticket: alert noise due to metric cardinality change; includes fix plan (dashboard/query update) and status updates.
Transcript of a technical deep dive with an enterprise prospect: discussion of how kernel selection works, GPU SKUs, long-context performance, rollout safety, and next steps to run benchmarks.
Transcript of a POC check-in: reviewing benchmark spreadsheet, addressing tail latency questions, and planning a dedicated pool test with specific GPUs.
CRM company record for a prospect evaluating Redwood for long-context summarization; notes include kernel selection questions, GPU constraints, POC timeline, and linked calls/tickets.
Leadership/manager email thread coordinating rollout risk review with Release Engineering and SRE: canary schedule, rollback authority, and customer comms guidance.
